_comment: GUI-C-228e. Data for Safety/MockBlockingStaticTests.cs. It is not compiled, so it cannot hide executable code. patterns: dynamic-load and reflection-creation APIs forbidden in every source compiled into the test assembly (the PDB Document list, linked and generated sources included), whatever the arguments are. EVERY line is scanned: nothing is classified as a comment or skipped. allowed: the exact lines that stay (repository-relative file + the whole trimmed line + why it loads no assembly and creates no app type). controls: one line each pattern must match. cases: synthetic sources run through the same scanner (expectHit says whether the scan must report something).

allowed.why: type comes from NativeTestClasses, a fixed array of three test classes of this assembly; the method is the private loader of a native module. No assembly is loaded and no app type is created.
reads this test class's own method to count its InlineData rows; the method is never invoked.
lists the public static member names of AlertDisplayFormatter (a source file linked into this assembly) to assert none is a severity override; names only, nothing is invoked.

app source linked into the test assembly. RequiredNames reads the constructor parameter names of a record type; both of its call sites pass a compile-time token (typeof of PreprocessSyntheticOracleResult and of PreprocessSyntheticStageResult). It only reads parameter names, invokes nothing, loads no assembly and creates no app type.
